t.zh: 饱和器推出几十条子句，推出 ⊥ 用到的只有几条。从 ⊥ 顺着来源往回找，得到的就是一份<wiki-ref to="certificate"></wiki-ref>：哪两条消出哪一条。
t.en: The saturator makes dozens of clauses, and ⊥ needs only a few. Tracing ⊥ back through where each clause came from gives a <wiki-ref to="certificate"></wiki-ref>: which two cancel into which.

after.en: Finding a proof is hard; checking one is easy.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，从「闹钟响了 → 我起床了」「我起床了 → 我喝了咖啡」「闹钟响了」推出 ⊥，看结果里的证书。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that reaches ⊥ from “the alarm rings → I get up”, “I get up → I drink coffee” and “the alarm rings”, and look at the certificate in the result.

hint.en: The proof assistant of <level-ref to="au-sledge"></level-ref> will do.

briefNote.zh: 按照证明助手的证书，在证明板上重放。
briefNote.en: Replay the proof assistant’s certificate on the proof board.

hint.zh: 证书里每一条推出的子句都写着它的两条来源。
hint.en: Each clause in the certificate names the two it came from.
